policy: Manually reviewed announcements from official Rockstar Games news and media pages. Scheduled checks create GitHub review issues and NEVER change this file.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album Is Out Now
articles.summary: Rockstar and Atlantic Records have released the official GTA VI soundtrack album on streaming services, with limited-edition vinyl and CD formats also announced.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 14

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Is Now Available
articles.summary: Rockstar marks the launch of GTA VI for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its announcement also links to the official media gallery and printable cover and map artwork.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 15

articles.title: Rockstar Releases Printable Leonida Map And Cover Art
articles.summary: Download official Leonida map and cover-art posters from Rockstar's GTA VI media section. Vice City Hub also has a separate zoomable map viewer.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 16

articles.title: Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now
articles.summary: Rockstar confirms eligible digital pre-orders can pre-load the game on supported consoles before launch.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 15

articles.title: Rockstar Announces GTA VI: The Festival
articles.summary: A launch-celebration concert is scheduled for 21 November at Mana Wynwood in Miami, with artists from the game's musical world.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 13

articles.title: New Launch Gallery Unveiled
articles.summary: Rockstar has added a fresh official collection of Leonida screenshots. Images remain behind our separate media reveal.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 27

articles.title: Regional Release Times Confirmed
articles.summary: Rockstar's published regional schedule sets the console release for 19 November 2026, at midnight local time.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 10

articles.title: Justice Composes GTA VI's Original Score
articles.summary: Rockstar confirms the French duo Justice composed the game's adaptive score; its 30-track score album is scheduled for 11 December.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 22

articles.title: The Official GTA VI Launch Trailer Is Here
articles.summary: Rockstar released its launch trailer ahead of November 19. It is entirely optional to watch; the video is never auto-played here.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 17

articles.title: Official GTA VI Collection Arrives At The Rockstar Store
articles.summary: Rockstar announced a collection of official Grand Theft Auto VI apparel and collectibles, including Vice City-inspired designs.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 17

articles.title: Radio Stations And Podcasts Detailed
articles.summary: Rockstar outlined six of GTA VI's in-game stations and confirmed on-demand podcasts, headphones and earbuds for listening beyond vehicles.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 07

articles.title: The Goodtime State — Vice City Collection Announced
articles.summary: Rockstar introduced its Goodtime State — Vice City merchandise collection, with a limited pre-order announcement and additional GTA VI store items planned.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 18

articles.title: GTA VI: The Album Coming On Launch Day
articles.summary: The separate official soundtrack album features 34 original tracks and is scheduled for 19 November alongside the game.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 25

articles.title: Rockstar Publishes An Extended Look
articles.summary: An official, in-game PlayStation 5 presentation is available to watch by choice. We do not reveal scenes or video thumbnails automatically.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 26

articles.title: GTA VI Pre-Orders And Editions Detailed
articles.summary: Rockstar opened pre-orders for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and confirmed its Ultimate Edition and Vintage Vice City Pack.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 01

articles.title: November 19 Release Date Announced
articles.summary: Rockstar's official announcement establishes the November 2026 console release date.
articles.imageAlt: Official Rockstar Games GTA VI promotional screenshot: Vice City 11
